propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently lives only in a non-gating inline step in prompt-eval.yml workflow, not in the default pytest suite that gates Verified votes
Three packaged plan-review specs shipped with datasets but no gold_set and merged Verified +1 while prompt-eval.yml was red, proving the inline check does not block submit

A unit test mirroring the inline CI logic must be added to test_eval_scorers.py to glob all packaged specs and assert validate_eval_spec(spec) and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) for dataset-bearing specs
The redundant inline validation step must be removed from prompt-eval.yml after the unit test is in place
The new test must be collected by the default pytest suite (non-integration, non-external) so it gates the Verified vote pre-merge
